authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5679 tapta gives northern tat/tatt/tāto hot and an explicit -ll extension tātal/tātalā. The t-final hot forms fit these documented continuations; tapo and talo need distinguishing verbal or lateral developments. Reviewed comparison: Rana tʌto “hot” (f_zfk6l2aerrnyo). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3832 kharva gives L./P. khabbā left, and explicit -ṭ extensions with xōṛi/khauṛi. The aspirated kh-bearing left forms fit those regional variants; unaspirated kab- is kept separate from the competing ḍābha family. Reviewed comparison: awan kʰaba “left” (f_ujpvblfvpl2to). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
